ns2:course.label: Choral Methods for Secondary Ensembles
ns2:course.description: Lecture/discussion methods course that addresses curriculum development, organization/administration, repertoire, vocal pedagogy and the changing voice, diction, and additional topics typical of secondary school choral music program. Prerequisite: MUS 240, MUS 350; or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MUS 240, MUS 350; or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to BME:Mus Ed:Choral Music-UIUC, BME:MusEd:Instrmntl Music-UIUC, BME:Mus Ed:Elem Gen Music-UIUC, or MME:Music Education -UIUC.
